notes: D1 oracle is docs/west-of-england-d1/oracle-clash-report.md only. No product lib/cities/west-of-england/ exists yet. Not generated from GTFS. No stopIds in this file.
Single agency, single direction model (destination + operator) — no two-layer hub problem like East Midlands' Nottingham Station. See direction-model-memo.md.
Modes v1: National Rail heavy rail only. No light rail, no metro, no buses (report line 22, C2/C3 point 7). MetroWest (future Portishead/Henbury reopenings) is explicitly out of v1 scope.

National Rail has NO static GTFS publication (Darwin is realtime-only, SOAP API). This is an open product-architecture question flagged by the report (C2/C3 point 5): does Next Train support Darwin-only next-train with no static-schedule supplement? Not resolved in this pack — see coverageGaps and jim-handoff.md.

Hub lock: Bristol Temple Meads (BRI). Hub secondary: Bath Spa (BTH). No doNotGroup needed at either — GWR-dominated single-operator termini, platforms distinguished by route not operator (report C2/C3 point 4).

Boundary through-running stations are NOT merge points at D1: Chepstow (CPW, South Wales boundary), Gloucester (GCR, West Midlands boundary), Westbury (WSB, Solent/Thames Valley boundary), Taunton (TAU, Southwest boundary). Flagged for D2 de-dup if/when those adjacent regions ship National Rail packs. South Wales's oracle report exists (docs/south-wales-d1/oracle-clash-report.md) but has not been packed by Luke yet as of this writing — do not treat that report as settling Chepstow's D2 treatment, only as a forward-reference that a South Wales pack will eventually need to reconcile with this one.

City lands as 'Coming Soon' (status stays planned; there is no separate coming-soon enum value in registry.js) until National Rail is unblocked, same as West Midlands / Greater Manchester / Liverpool City Region / East Midlands / North East.

No 'lines' array is provided — National Rail has no printed route/line map to transcribe. This is a flat station list (hub, secondary hub, through-running-only), not a lines array, matching the East Midlands National Rail precedent.

License: OGL 2.0 baseline with NRE amendments. Confidence 'unclear' on third-party rider redistribution via the RDM Platform Agreement — same open item as East Midlands (report License section). OPEN ITEM FOR TIM ONLY, do not resolve here.

printedInnerCityNames.note: Single-layer, single-agency hub pair — no doNotGroup needed between or within BRI/BTH. See hazard-pack.md H1/H6.

coverageGaps: National Rail real-time: OpenLDBWS documented and technically live, but BLOCKED at the account level (AU-registered RDM account; Tim re-registering with UK address). Not a feed problem. Do not wire DARWIN_LDB_TOKEN until it exists.

National Rail has NO static GTFS publication at all (unlike East Midlands' NET, which has DFT Bus Open Data GTFS as a schedule-only fallback). Open product question for Jim/Tim: can Next Train support a Darwin-only next-train model, or does it require a GTFS base layer? Not resolved in this pack — do not guess an answer.

National Rail licensing: OGL 2.0 baseline permits redistribution with attribution, but the RDM Platform Agreement's language on downstream redistribution to third-party rider clients is UNCLEAR in public sources. Confidence: unclear (per oracle report License section). OPEN ITEM FOR TIM ONLY — do not resolve here; do not assume permission to relay Darwin data to end users until Tim confirms against the signed RDM Data Sharing Agreement.

National Rail has no printed route/line map to transcribe (Darwin is a real-time per-station board product) — no 'lines' array is provided, only the hub/secondary/through-running station list. See direction-model-memo.md for the destination+operator model recommended instead of line+terminus.

Boundary de-dup with South Wales (Chepstow), West Midlands (Gloucester), Solent/Thames Valley (Westbury), and Southwest (Taunton) is explicitly out of scope for this pack — D2 concern for future packs in those regions. South Wales already has an unpacked oracle report; the other three regions have no report yet as of this writing.
No buses, no light rail, no trams in v1 scope, per the oracle report. MetroWest (planned half-hourly frequency, future Portishead/Henbury reopenings) is out.

hub.name: Bristol Temple Meads
hub.class: hub lock — principal rail terminus for Bristol city; all regional and inter-city services call here. GWR ticket office, Paddington services, Southwest connections.

secondaryHub.name: Bath Spa
secondaryHub.class: hub secondary — Bath city station; direct service to Bristol Temple Meads (11-19 min frequency). Regional connections north to Gloucester and east to Westbury.

throughRunningOnly.name: Chepstow
throughRunningOnly.class: through-running only, boundary to South Wales region — not a merge. De-duplicate at D2 if South Wales region enters the app.

throughRunningOnly.name: Gloucester
throughRunningOnly.class: through-running only, boundary to West Midlands region — not a merge. Cross-region operator continuity (GWR regional + CrossCountry Cardiff-Nottingham long-distance).

throughRunningOnly.name: Westbury
throughRunningOnly.class: through-running only, boundary to Solent/Thames Valley regions — not a merge. GWR to Reading/Oxford (Thames Valley) and SWR to Southampton/Portsmouth (Solent) call at same platform, separate franchises. De-duplicate at D2 if adjacent regions enter the app.

throughRunningOnly.name: Taunton
throughRunningOnly.class: through-running only, toward Southwest/Devon region — not a merge. GWR continues west to Exeter and beyond.
